description: This file implements the AIConfiguration class, which manages configuration parameters for AI components within a plugin framework. It includes methods for reading configuration data from a file or custom defaults, parsing JSON arrays, and printing configuration details for verification.

classes.name: AIConfiguration
classes.description: A class responsible for managing AI-related configuration parameters, including reading from configuration files, setting default values, and providing accessors for various configuration options.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the configuration by reading from the configuration file.

methods.name: readFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads configuration parameters from a specified ini file, parsing key-value pairs and updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: readFromCustomData
methods.description: Sets default configuration values when the configuration file cannot be read.

methods.name: printAIConfiguration
methods.description: Outputs current configuration parameters for verification and debugging.
